title: If they are talking behind your back, it’s only because you are ahead of them. 💯
paragraphs: If they are talking behind your back, it’s only because you are ahead of them. 💯

Stop getting distracted by people who aren't even on your track. The noise of the crowd always gets loudest when you're about to break through. People who are truly busy building their own Kingdom foundation don't have time to try and tear down yours.
Let them talk while you keep walking. Your assignment is too important to look back.
🔥 "The Lord is on my side; I will not fear. What can man do to me?" - Psalm 118:6
👇 Follow for daily spiritual battles and motivation.
